description: Disability-inclusive language and WCAG 2.1 AA content checks (UIC requires WCAG 2.1 AA).

rules.name: Non-descriptive link text
rules.message: Use link text that describes where the link goes, e.g. "View the fall course schedule".
rules.source: WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page)

rules.name: ALL CAPS text
rules.message: Avoid phrases in all capital letters; some screen readers spell them out. Use sentence case.
rules.source: WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page); UIC Editorial guide: Capitalization (avoid unnecessary capitals)

rules.name: Disability language

pattern.special needs: (be specific about the needs or services)

rules.message: Use the language in UIC's Inclusive Language Guide: state facts neutrally, focus on what people can do, and avoid disability idioms.

rules.name: Image without alt text
rules.message: Every image needs alt text that describes it for blind users.
rules.source: UIC Social media guidelines (alt text on every photo); WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page)

rules.name: Raw URL as link text
rules.message: Screen readers read raw URLs character by character. Link descriptive text instead.
rules.source: WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page)

rules.name: Sensory or directional instructions
rules.message: Don't rely on position or color alone; name the section or item directly.
rules.source: WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page)
rules.suggestion: Refer to the item by name

rules.name: Unfamiliar acronym
rules.message: Avoid acronyms except broadly understood ones like UIC.

rules.name: Too many emojis
rules.message: Limit emojis; screen readers announce each one by name.
rules.source: Team-defined (accessibility best practice; not on the UIC site)

rules.name: Hashtag not in CamelCase
rules.message: Capitalize each word in multi-word hashtags (e.g. #UICFlamesForward) so screen readers pronounce them correctly.
rules.source: Team-defined (accessibility best practice; not on the UIC site)
rules.suggestion: Capitalize each word in the hashtag

rules.name: Details only in an image or attachment
rules.message: Put key details (date, time, location) in the text; images and flyers may not be accessible.
rules.source: WCAG 2.1 AA (required by UIC ADA compliance page)
rules.suggestion: Include the details in the message text
